configuration:
models: []
rails:
  input:
    flows: [citizen input]
  output:
    flows: [citizen output]
colang:
define bot refuse to respond
  "I cannot disclose credentials or promise unsupported outcomes. I can help with published learning options."

define flow citizen input
  $allowed = execute citizen_input_allowed
  if not $allowed
    bot refuse to respond
    stop

define flow citizen output
  $allowed = execute citizen_output_allowed
  if not $allowed
    bot refuse to respond
    stop
